visualCharacteristics.purpose: Embedded video player (YouTube, Vimeo, mp4) optionally behind a poster image with a play button; several videos sit side by side

contentPattern.structure: One row per video: optional poster image, the video URL as a link, optional caption text. Two or more rows render as a two-up grid

reuseGuidance: Use for standalone embedded videos. Background videos inside a banner belong to hero-banner (video option).
